headline: French Debt Woes Take Center Stage Ahead of ECB Policy Meeting
summary: France's deteriorating public finances are the focus as European Central Bank policymakers convene, though no immediate financial lifeline is expected for the eurozone's second-biggest economy.
why: As a core member of the eurozone, France's fiscal deficits and debt trajectory directly influence sovereign debt yields and broader monetary policy discussions within the European Union.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Sovereign fiscal stress in major member states can create volatility for European currency and debt markets.
